settings.label: Logo image
settings.info: Optional. PNG or SVG with a transparent background works best on the red header. If not set, the inline red shield ('QUALITY · DAMON · PRODUCTS') is used.

settings.label: Logo alt text
settings.info: Used for screen readers and SEO.

settings.label: Logo max height
settings.info: Header is sized for ~44px tall logos.

settings.label: Show wordmark text next to logo
settings.info: Uncheck if your logo already includes the brand name, or if you only want the shield/image to appear in the header.

settings.label: Wordmark text
settings.info: Leave blank to use the shop name from Settings → Store details.

settings.label: Favicon (32×32)
settings.info: Square PNG. Used in browser tabs and bookmarks.

settings.label: Damon red
settings.info: Header background, primary CTAs, badges, accents.

settings.label: Damon red — hover
settings.info: Hover state for primary buttons and red surfaces.

settings.label: Page background
settings.info: Background color behind every page. Warm off-white reads less stark than pure white. Pure white (#FFFFFF) is fine if you prefer that.

settings.label: Default product image
settings.info: Shown when a product has no image uploaded. Used on product cards (collection grids, featured products) and on the PDP main image. Falls back to Shopify's standard placeholder when blank.

settings.label: Variable-price prefix
settings.info: Shown before the price on product cards (and search results) when the product has multiple variants at different prices. Common alternatives: "As low as", "From". Leave blank to show only the price with no prefix.

settings.label: Account icon in white circle
settings.info: When on, the profile silhouette sits inside a white circle for an avatar-like treatment. When off, just the profile icon renders in the header color.

settings.label: Cart icon in white circle
settings.info: Same circle treatment for the cart truck icon. Keep both on to match each other.

settings.content: Applies site-wide to every button, text input, search field, chip, badge, and active nav state. Truly circular elements (avatars, dots, hero rings) are unaffected.

settings.label: Corner radius
settings.info: 0 = square. 3 = sharp. 6 = matches the Damon shield. 30 = strongly rounded. For a true pill shape, tick the box below.

settings.label: Use full pill instead
settings.info: When on, ignores the slider and uses a 999px radius for that classic capsule look. Turn off to use the slider value.

settings.content: Gates the Add-to-cart button across the PDP, product cards, collections, recommendations — any surface that uses the shared product card. Requires the Locksmith Shopify app installed, with 'Enable manual locking' ticked under Advanced on each lock. Leave off until Locksmith is installed and locks are configured.

settings.label: Enable Locksmith manual mode site-wide
settings.info: When on, every product surface calls Locksmith's locksmith-variables snippet to check access. Fail-secure: if the snippet is missing, errors, or returns anything other than 'true', the product stays locked. When off, Locksmith logic is skipped entirely and Add-to-cart renders normally.

settings.label: Preview as locked (theme editor only)
settings.info: Forces the locked UI inside the Shopify theme editor so you can verify the Request access state. Gated by request.design_mode — has no effect on the live storefront. Locksmith normally grants admin users access, which is why the editor preview otherwise looks unlocked.

settings.label: HubSpot portal ID
settings.info: Used by the site-wide tracking script (drops the hubspotutk cookie so form submissions can be tied to a visitor's full pageview history) and by any section that POSTs to a HubSpot form.

settings.label: Load HubSpot tracking script site-wide
settings.info: Uncheck to disable HubSpot pageview tracking entirely. Form submissions still work but won't carry hutk attribution.

settings.label: Load ZoomInfo tracking script site-wide
settings.info: Loads the ZoomInfo WebSights snippet on every page — identifies visiting companies by IP for sales intel. Deferred, non-blocking. Uncheck to disable entirely (e.g. in EU/opt-out contexts).

settings.label: Rep link label
settings.info: Used by the PDP rep link and other places that point users to your contact page.

settings.label: Rep link target page
settings.info: Pick the page this link should open. If left blank, defaults to /pages/contact-rep.

settings.content: Defaults for the four ship-row tiles. Each can be overridden per-product via the damon.* metafields.

settings.label: Free freight at (USD)
settings.info: Cart subtotal at which freight becomes free. Drives the progress bar in the cart drawer.
